messages:
mira: FYI StellarHealth asked for an Optimize toolkit pilot: per-route quant fallback, adaptive batching presets, prefix/KV caching, and eval-triggered alerts. They want a tight acceptance bar before GA.

jordan: quick feasibility check? p95 latency and quality tradeoffs?

mira: they want p95 <= 120ms for short chat flows, and <= 3% drop in task accuracy on their health prompt set. Alert when concordance drops >5 pts over a 1k-window.

andrew: 120ms p95 is tight on hosted unless batching is conservative (batch<=4) + high cache-hit. Dedicated handles it better. Quant fallback per-route works: default quantized, fallback to fp16 on eval regression.

sasha: need defined rollback/hysteresis: require 2 windows before auto-fallback to avoid flapping. Also expose route-level opt-out for fallback.

mira: pilot scope proposal: 1) adaptive batching presets (mobile/desktop), 2) prefix/KV caching, 3) per-route quant with manual canary + eval-triggered auto-fallback (with hysteresis), 4) alert webhook to customer and ops. No kernel/compile changes in pilot.

jordan: pin model variants for pilot. Provide char->token mapping and a cost-estimate example.

andrew: draft acceptance criteria: perf: p95 <= 120ms on 90% of pilot routes (24h windows); quality: accuracy drop <=3% vs fp16 baseline on customer eval; alerting: webhook delivered within 5m when concordance delta >5pt; observability: token-level cost per-route in console.

sasha: ops constraints: per-customer cache quota + LRU eviction. Default 5GB per tenant; increases require infra sign-off.

mira: customer requested a control-plane knob: quant_fallback: on|off|auto. We'll expose that.

jordan: config sketch:
```yaml
route: /stella/chat
quant_profile: r4-24q
quant_fallback: auto
batching: preset: mobile_small
cache: prefix: enabled, size_mb: 512
eval_alerts: threshold_pts: 5, window: 1000, webhook: https://hooks.stellar/alerts
```

andrew: timeline: 2-week sprint to implement flags + alerting + demo, then 1-week pilot.

sasha: risks: noisy eval -> flapping, cache warm-up causing early latency, token-cost surprises.

mira: mitigations: hysteresis (2 windows), warm-up note in onboarding, include simple cost simulation in console.

andrew: actions: @jordan spec for SDK/route flags, @sasha cache quota + eviction proposal, @mira pilot acceptance sheet and runbook.

jordan: Ill open a minimal PR for route flags + e2e test to simulate degradation->fallback. ETA EOD Fri.

sasha: Ill post cache proposal in #eng-infra and tag infra leads.

mira: ops-bot: create pilot-tracker with tags optimize-pilot and stellarhealth

ops-bot: Created ticket TID-3421: "optimize-pilot/stellahealth"  assignees: mira, jordan, sasha, andrew.

mira: keeping scope tight: no kernel perf work for pilot. If pilot shows a need, schedule compile work next cycle.

jordan: adding eval harness to run customers 500-prompt subset every 10m and publish concordance to alert pipeline.

andrew: after acceptance we capture a GA runbook: defaults, knobs, SLOs, rollback steps.

mira: sync tomorrow 10am to review PRs and tracker. :thumbsup:
